classified as irrigated and rainfed (barani). There is a
difference in the nature of irrigated farming, as well as based on the

objective of protective irrigation is to protect the crops from adverse
effects of soil moisture deficiency, which often means that
irrigation acts as a supplementary source of water over and above the
rainfall. The strategy of this kind of irrigation is to provide
soil moisture to the maximum possible area. Productive irrigation is meant

season to achieve high productivity. In such irrigation, the water input per

irrigation. Rainfed farming is further classified on the basis of adequacy of
